note: Form-only revision against SPEC rule 5/6: R-14 (no wall clock/persistence/timers) cannot be tested through the public API, so it is marked manual as the planner prompt prescribes; the Author's question about merge priority is answered by SPEC rule 5 (base priority), so it is removed and recorded as an assumption; C-12 contained only the unanswered question instead of an expected result and is dropped (C-11 still covers merge). No expected result was added or changed.

requirements.text: Export createTickets({ now = () => 0, reopenWindow = 100, maxReopens = 2, escalateAfter = 50 } = {}). Validate that now is a function, reopenWindow and escalateAfter are positive safe integers, and maxReopens is a nonnegative safe integer; invalid configuration throws an Error with code INVALID_INPUT.
All failures throw Error objects whose code is a string. A failed call leaves ticket state unchanged.

create requires a nonempty string id and subject, and priority equal to low, normal, high, or urgent; invalid values fail with INVALID_INPUT. An id previously used, including one belonging to a merged ticket, fails with ID_TAKEN.
A newly created ticket has status open, assignee null, and reopenCount 0. Its creation time is obtained from now().
Methods operating on an unknown ticket id fail with UNKNOWN_TICKET. assign requires a nonempty string agent and otherwise fails with INVALID_INPUT.

Only these transitions succeed: assign from open, assigned, or pending sets status assigned and sets or replaces the assignee; wait changes assigned to pending; customerReply changes pending to assigned while keeping its assignee; resolve changes assigned to resolved and records the call time; reopen changes resolved to assigned, keeps its assignee, and increments reopenCount; close changes resolved to closed. Other transitions fail with BAD_STATE.

reopen fails with REOPEN_LIMIT when reopenCount is at least maxReopens; otherwise it succeeds if the ticket is resolved and within its reopen window. A ticket resolved again after reopening starts a new window at the new resolve time.

A resolved ticket is closed automatically when now() is at least resolvedAt + reopenWindow. This status is reflected by get, list, and method state checks; before that threshold, the ticket remains resolved and can be reopened.

A ticket not assigned before createdAt + escalateAfter becomes escalated at that threshold and remains escalated even if assigned later. A ticket assigned before the threshold is never escalated by this rule. Escalation raises effectivePriority by one level (low to normal, normal to high, high to urgent, urgent remains urgent).

merge requires different source and target ids (otherwise SAME_TICKET), and both tickets must be open, assigned, or pending (otherwise BAD_STATE). On success, source status becomes merged and mergedInto is the target id; source cannot transition to another status. Target retains its status and assignee, takes the higher priority, and is escalated from then on if either ticket was escalated at merge time.
Ticket views contain id, subject, priority, effectivePriority, status, assignee (null when unassigned), and reopenCount. They include mergedInto only for merged tickets.

get returns the ticket view as of now(). create, assign, wait, customerReply, resolve, reopen, and close return the changed ticket's view; merge returns the target ticket's view. Methods are synchronous and their results may be awaited.

list accepts optional status and assignee filters and returns tickets matching every supplied filter as of now(). An invalid status (not one of the six statuses) fails with INVALID_INPUT; assignee must be a string. Results sort by effectivePriority descending from urgent to low, then by creation order.
The service does not read a wall clock, persist data, use network access, schedule timers, or require cleanup.
Do not add behavior or API beyond the stated ticket workflow contract.

notApplicable.reason: Public API không có người dùng, vai trò, quyền hoặc ranh giới truy cập; R-1 đến R-14 không quy định hành vi authorization để kiểm thử.
Hợp đồng quy định methods synchronous và dữ liệu chỉ trong bộ nhớ; không có thao tác đồng thời, khóa hoặc thứ tự cạnh tranh được quy định. Không áp đặt semantics concurrency ngoài hợp đồng.
Hợp đồng không yêu cầu dịch vụ phụ thuộc bên ngoài; R-14 loại trừ network, persistence, timers và cleanup.

assumptions: Các giá trị now() được cung cấp tuân theo tiền điều kiện của hợp đồng: số nguyên an toàn không âm và không giảm; không cần quy định xử lý khi bên gọi vi phạm tiền điều kiện này.
Hợp đồng không quy định thứ tự ưu tiên lỗi khi một lời gọi đồng thời vi phạm nhiều điều kiện độc lập; acceptance tests không kết hợp các lỗi như vậy.
merge compares the `priority` fields of the two tickets (SPEC rule 5: the target's `priority` becomes the higher of the two priorities); `effectivePriority` is not used for that comparison.
acceptanceExamples: Với now trả về 10, tạo ticket id T1, subject Login, priority low: view có status open, assignee null, reopenCount 0, effectivePriority low.
Tạo ticket tại thời điểm 0 với escalateAfter 50; tại thời điểm 50, get cho effectivePriority tăng một bậc nếu ticket chưa từng được assign.
Assign ticket trước createdAt + escalateAfter thì ticket không bị escalation theo quy tắc thời gian, kể cả khi được kiểm tra sau ngưỡng.
Resolve tại thời điểm 20 với reopenWindow 100: tại thời điểm 119 ticket vẫn resolved và có thể reopen; tại thời điểm 120, get/list phản ánh closed.
Với maxReopens 1, resolve rồi reopen thành công một lần; sau khi resolve lại, lần reopen tiếp theo thất bại với REOPEN_LIMIT.
Merge một ticket high vào ticket low đang mở: ticket nguồn thành merged với mergedInto là id đích; ticket đích giữ trạng thái và assignee, có priority high.
interfaces: createTickets({ now, reopenWindow, maxReopens, escalateAfter }) trả về service có create({ id, subject, priority }), assign(id, agent), wait(id), customerReply(id), resolve(id), reopen(id), close(id), merge(sourceId, targetId), get(id), và list({ status, assignee }).
scope: Phạm vi triển khai là workflow ticket hỗ trợ lưu trong bộ nhớ và public API được nêu trong yêu cầu.
Không mở rộng sang persistence, network, timer, cleanup, hoặc API bổ sung.
